data_policy_contract_notes: The public Token Factory terms apply to the standard Fast API route. Customers can opt out of storage and speculative-decoding processing, but the catalogue does not model customer-specific opt-out state.
residency_notes: For public model endpoints, processing location depends on the selected model and is shown in the interface; Nebius documents hosting in the EU (including Finland and France), Israel, and the United States. Dedicated endpoint regions are selected during endpoint configuration. Fine-tuning processing locations are fixed and resulting data is stored in the EU.
prompt_training_notes: Nebius Token Factory's public Terms of Service say it collects and processes Inputs and Outputs for training smaller speculative-decoding models, while allowing customers to opt out of storage and that processing.

sources.notes: Documents the Fast flavor and the required -fast model suffix.

Section 7 says Nebius may host, cache, store, and modify Inputs and Outputs and collects/processes them to train smaller speculative-decoding models; customers may opt out. This governs the standard Fast API route.

verification.notes: Verified shared API host, Fast suffix semantics, and Chat/Responses transport. Policy classification follows the standard public Token Factory terms; no Phaseo-specific ZDR opt-out state is assumed.
